entities.summary: Bhutan is a sovereign nation in South Asia, Asia. Its capital is Thimphu. Official languages include Dzongkha. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy. Population: approximately 0.8 million. Area: 38,394 km². Comprehensive index for Bhutan covering early Bon religion, Guru Rinpoche (Padmasambhava) and Buddhism, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal unification (1616), Dzong fortress system, British influence, Wangchuck monarchy (1907), modernisation under third and fourth kings, Gross National Happiness, democratic transition 2008, and Lhotshampa refugee crisis.
